propositions: Replace dual link-parsing logic (top-level index checker and outbound test parser) with single deterministic repository-relative link validator operating across an explicit maintained-documentation boundary.

Expand link validation source scope to include root Markdown, agent configs, GitHub workflows, infra runbooks, guide and eval specs, templates, and test fixtures while excluding prompts, reviewers, and local Markdown files.

Resolve relative Markdown links and images from source directories to any target inside the repository, rejecting targets that escape it, while ignoring scheme-qualified targets, fragment-only targets, fenced code blocks, inline code, and HTML links.
Generate deterministic findings with repository-relative source path, line number, raw target, normalized target path, and failure reason for missing targets and out-of-repository escapes.
Document the maintained source boundary, parser behavior, and exclusions in docs/documentation-policy.md.
Retain existing top-level docs index membership validation as a separate rule and preserve CI action invocation without expanding into anchor validation, external URL checks, or prose analysis.
